emily_marketing: Heads-up: ReefInsights gave greenlight for a case study. Need interview, signed release, screenshots, and ES/DE microcopy. Target publish in two weeks. Who owns what?

 raj_se: I can do the demo + bring P95 charts and cost delta. Suggest Wed 17:00 CET.

 nora_editor: Ill transcribe and draft 2 quote lengths. Are raw numbers OK to publish?

 sara_legal: We need a signed testimonial release before metrics go live. Uploaded template: https://drive.redwood.company/Reef-release. If customer declines numbers, use relative phrasing.

 max_ops: Will schedule recording (Zoom) and enable captions.

 emily_marketing: Interview focus: 1) previous infra pain, 2) measurable wins (or qualitative), 3) ops workflow improvements. Keep answers short.

 marta_loc: I can localize Spanish and German after final copy within 48 hrs. Provide glossary link.

 leo_prod: I'll prepare a 2-paragraph technical appendix describing routing and quantization used.

 nora_editor: Post-call deliverables: quotes, 150-word blurb, social pull quotes. Target Fri EOD for drafts so legal can review.

 sara_legal: Send signed release to contact: oliver@reefinsights.ai.

 emily_marketing: Thanks team — I'll confirm slot and send invite. Will track checklist here. :rocket:
